The ranger's skin stretches, his nose becomes hooked, and his eyes enlarge. While in this form, the ranger gains a +10 bonus on Perception checks.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter

The ranger's skin stretches, his nose becomes hooked, and his eyes enlarge. While in this form, the ranger gains a +10 bonus on Perception checks and a fly speed of 40 feet with good maneuverability. Alternatively, the ranger can polymorph into the form of an eagle or similar raptor as if the caster of beast shape IV.|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter
